hooks.name: 读图前缩小 extract 临时图至 1568px
hooks.description: 当 agent 用 read_file 读取 extract/ 临时目录下的图片时，若长边超过 1568px 则就地缩小，避免触发 Anthropic API 的 many-image 2000px 限制。只作用于 extract/ 临时产物，docs/assets/ 归档原图不受影响。

action.command: HOOK=$(cat); F=$(printf '%s' "$HOOK" | jq -r '.tool_input.path // empty'); case "$F" in *"/extract/"*) : ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; printf '%s' "$F" | grep -qiE '\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|tiff|bmp)$' || exit 0; [ -f "$F" ] || exit 0; W=$(sips -g pixelWidth "$F" 2>/dev/null | awk '/pixelWidth:/{print $2}'); H=$(sips -g pixelHeight "$F" 2>/dev/null | awk '/pixelHeight:/{print $2}'); [ -n "$W" ] && [ -n "$H" ] || exit 0; L=$(( W > H ? W : H )); [ "$L" -gt 1568 ] && sips -Z 1568 "$F" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
